report:
# Audit Report

I independently inspected the repository and cross-checked the executor's claims against real artifacts. I ran `npm run validate` and `npm run build:prod` myself in the workspace.

## Verification by phase

**1. Foundation — PASS.** `theme.css` defines `--ext-success/warning/info/running` (+deep/bright/foreground/muted) in the light (`:root`), dark (`[data-theme='dark']`), and system-preference (`@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)`) blocks — confirmed by grep, and the runner guard enforces ≥3 occurrences per token. `ui-primitives.css` (buttons, chips, badges, trays, sections, run indicators, reduced-motion) is real and loaded by both `chat.html` and `options.html`. `src/utils/runState.js` implements the canonical idle/running/streaming/stopping/complete/error/stopped vocabulary with `aria-busy` mirroring; `chat.js` genuinely wires it (`beginRunUi`, `resetRunUi`, `handleRunFailure`, `stopApiRequest`).

**2. Chat-first slice — PASS.** `chat.html` has `#context-tray` (attachment/selected-text/page-context strips) and `#quick-actions-row`. `src/chat/ChatComposer.js` is substantive (353 lines, observer-driven): `getContextState`/`getQuickActions` (Analyze/Proofread/Explain; Summary/TL;DR/Technical), idempotent `ensureStopButton`, `ensureRecoveryRow` (Retry/Edit/Continue), and `initComposer` wired in `chat.js`. Continue routes to `previous_response` context; Edit loads the last prompt; Stop aborts the run. Capabilities remain visible-but-secondary in the sidebar. 56 vitest tests across the three new test files pass.

**3. Options — PASS.** `options.html`/`options.js` + `src/options/OptionsUI.js` implement Get Started banner with live connection status and Open Chat (routes through the `openChat` funnel), explicit per-section saves (Connection/Privacy/Web Search) with `flashSaveFeedback`, 4 capability badges (Instructions, Skills, Tools, Web Search), credential masking (`applyCredentialMask` keeps keys out of inputs; copy fetches from storage; masked-save preserves stored keys for both profile and Brave keys), three dirty trackers, visible `unsaved-banner`, and `beforeunload` guard.

**4. Entry points — PASS.** `background.js` `openChatWithContext` funnel preserves selection/media/instruction; toolbar `chrome.action.onClicked`, internal `openChat`, and `chrome.runtime.onMessageExternal` all route through it. `manifest.json` adds `action` + `externally_connectable` (promptpaul.juanmackie.com), mirrored in `dist`. `chat.js` consumes deep-link `textPrompt` against attached context. Context-menu flows audited and intact.

**5. Compatibility — PASS.** Runner guard pins all canonical storage keys (profiles, lastSelectedProfileId, instructions, skills, tools, analyticsConsent, voiceInputEnabled, braveSearchApiKey, webSearchEnabled); backup/import/export + key-disclosure warning intact; "retire nothing" guard checks capability entry points. 70 runner tests pass.

**6. Coordinated release — PASS.** I ran `build:prod`; `dist/` ships all phases (ChatComposer.js, OptionsUI.js, runState.js, ui-primitives.css, root CSS, manifest). CHANGELOG/README/ARCHITECTURE updated accordingly.

**7. Validation — PASS (re-run by me).** `npm run validate`: lint 0 errors, prettier check clean, 70 runner + 256 vitest tests pass, smoke passes. `docs/UX_JOURNEYS.md` documents 3 journeys × 5 axes plus WCAG AA best-effort checklist, and the code actually implements the listed items (skip link, `aria-busy`, `aria-pressed`, `role=group` recovery rows, `aria-live` banner, `:focus-visible`, reduced-motion).

## Notes / weak evidence
- "Live browser verification" claims (chat and options) are not reproducible in this isolated environment; however, they are supplementary — the functional code, 56 new unit tests, 70 runner guards, and a green full validation independently substantiate the same behavior.
- No TODO/FIXME stubs in new modules; no schema changes; pre-existing Brave-grounding uncommitted work was left as-is (its diff is unrelated to the UX work).

All explicit requirements are implemented, wired into the actual surfaces, and verified by real artifacts and passing suites. No data-loss, entry-path, or parity regressions found.
